# ForgeSpan Metals

> ForgeSpan Metals manufactures metal roofing, wall panels, trim, structural building components, and complete steel building packages for agricultural, commercial, industrial, and residential projects. Serving West Texas, the Texas Panhandle, eastern New Mexico, western Oklahoma, and surrounding regional markets, with pickup and regional jobsite delivery.

## Panels

- [Panel Profiles](/panels): Overview of all metal panel profiles.
- [FS-R36 Structural Rib Panel](/panels/fs-r36): Exposed-fastener structural rib panel, 36" coverage, 1-1/4" ribs on 12" centers, 24/26/29 gauge.
- [FS-A36 Agricultural Panel](/panels/fs-a36): Agricultural profile, 36" coverage, 3/4" ribs on 9" centers, 26/29 gauge.
- [FS-U36 Utility Panel](/panels/fs-u36): Utility profile, 36" coverage, 3/4" ribs on 6" centers, 26/29 gauge.
- [FS-S16 Standing Seam Panel](/panels/fs-s16): Concealed-fastener standing seam roofing, 16" coverage, 24/26 gauge.
- [FS-I40 Insulated Wall Panel](/panels/fs-i40): Insulated sandwich wall panel, 40" coverage, 2"–4" thickness.
- [FS-L29 Interior Liner Panel](/panels/fs-l29): Light-gauge interior liner panel, 36" coverage, 29 gauge.
- [Color Chart](/colorchart): 30 standard factory-applied panel colors.
